Amazon Box Returned with a Recording Device Inside

2024
Smartphone with custom recording software, returned to Amazon.de; audio
ZK/U, Berlin

A smartphone bought from Amazon.de and altered to record its own return. Sent back through the platform’s returns process, the phone recorded 52 hours of transit to its eventual destination and transmitted the audio to the artist over the cell network. Exhibited alongside Return to Sender at ZK/U in Berlin, the recording makes audible a journey that the customer who starts it never sees.
